title: Paying the Coming Month in Advance — Independent Living Residency Agreement Payment Option
content:
**Product:** Independent Living Residency Agreement. **Subject:** advance payment for the coming calendar month.

## The option

A resident of a continuing independent living residency — or the resident's financial representative — may ask to pay in advance for the coming calendar month. The advance payment is made by one-time ACH draft from the payer's own bank account, for the advance amount set for the coming month on the residency.

## Business effect

The payment posts on the residency ledger, dated the day it is made, under a newly issued ACH trace reference, and lowers the account balance owed by the amount paid. The account balance may show a credit afterwards.

## Invocation — `make_advance_payment_0a0cd4e1`

**Owner and access.** This is a customer-side tool. The agent unlocks `make_advance_payment_0a0cd4e1` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the resident or the resident's financial representative — runs it, authorizing the one-time ACH draft in person.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `independent_residency_id` | The reference number of the independent living residency agreement the payment is for, as given by the Resident and Family Services representative from the residency lookup | Text identifier |
| `amount` | The amount drawn from the payer's bank account | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success the payment appears on the ledger and the residency's account balance falls by the amount. The receipt lists `independent_entry_id` (the reference number of the payment entry), `payment_reference` (the ACH trace reference issued for this draft, to keep), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `payment_method` (always `ach_one_time`), `account_balance` (the balance owed after the payment, USD with 2 decimal places, negative when the account holds a credit) and `status`, reading `payment_posted`.

## Contract questions

**Who runs the payment?** The customer themselves; the representative gives the residency reference from the lookup.

**What payment method does the entry carry?** Always one-time ACH (`ach_one_time`).

**Can the balance become negative?** Yes; a negative account balance on the receipt means the account holds a credit.

Hypothetical receipt: an `amount` of 5,250.00 on a residency owing 0.00 returns an `account_balance` of -5250.0 and `payment_posted`.
